layout.observations: One compact three-line block: 서로, 다른, 속도. The line breaks are between whole words and are permitted soft wrapping.

text.observations: All six syllables are readable in all three views, in their required order.

style.checked_requirement: Constructed cut-paper gear pair, coherent shallow planes, larger angular sweep on smaller wheel, compact firm Hangul near mesh.

observations.observation: Cobalt and vermilion matte paper, pale layered arc sectors and plain hubs remain. Diagonal center arrangement and unequal radii remain.

issues: Contact is still shallow. Fine curled paper texture is more conspicuous than the initial view.

observations.observation: Unequal substantial gear silhouettes dominate the field independently of the title.

observations.location: two pale sectors and gear bodies
observations.observation: The small wheel retains a substantially greater swept angle; the unequal toothed bodies are connected along the shared diagonal.

issues: Tooth engagement does not extend cleanly into two or three opposing valleys.

observations.observation: Unwarped six syllables with intact component proportions and open counters; the title stays in one firm three-line block.

observations.location: shared wedge left of orange wheel
observations.observation: Title is still a counterweight beside the wheels, clear of the diagonal contact. The bottom line stays just above the blue teeth.

The orange wheel sits closer to blue. A blue tooth and orange tooth contact oblique edges, but broad tooth ends remain near the mouths of opposing gaps rather than deeper alternating tooth-into-valley engagement.

issues: Rebuild compatible local tooth phasing and deeper tooth-valley engagement.

observations.observation: Short down-right shadows remain coherent. Fine curled or maze-like fibers now cover most broad surfaces with similar prominence, reducing the calm solid-paper character.

issues: Lower the fine fiber contrast without replacing the cut-paper material.

observations.observation: Overall weight, title reading and recognizable wheel pair were preserved; the orange wheel moved lower, tightening the connection.
Sector widths now vary slightly in opposite senses; the change is too subtle to make opposite rotations clear at thumbnail size.

residuals.limit: The connection is closer but still shallow; clear engagement of alternating teeth into matching valleys remains uncertain.
More conspicuous curled texture repeats across background and wheels.
Opposite rotation is only weakly suggested by sector width changes, especially at reduced size.
